thread:
paula_support: FYI customer #9876 (EU) opened escalation — says their data wasn't fully deleted after a DPA erasure. They want proof of deletion and any KMS/HSM access logs. ticket: TCK-9876

mike_sre: Thanks. Can you paste the customer_id + example request id? also any timestamps they gave?

paula_support: customer_id=cust-9876, provided request id delete_req_2026-03-06_15:42Z. Says they retried because UI showed 'in progress' for 3 days.

lana_security: @mike_sre @aj_engineer I need to know if the deletion path touched HSM-backed key material or only KMS envelopes. Quick checks: key_id used, key rotation events, and HSM access logs (if any). Also legal wants chain-of-subprocessors to confirm no downstream retention.

aj_engineer: Quick summary from infra: deletion is async via deletion-worker -> archive-cleaner pipeline. Typical flow: mark user shards deleted in DB, enqueue archive-cleaner which deletes S3 objects and calls KMS/HSM to remove envelope keys. If archive-cleaner fails, we retry with exponential backoff up to 72h then mark as 'failed-manual'.

aj_engineer: Repro steps to check for this customer:
```
# check deletion job status
SELECT id, status, last_attempt, attempts FROM deletion_jobs WHERE customer_id='cust-9876' ORDER BY last_attempt DESC LIMIT 10;
# check archive-cleaner logs (k8s namespace: archive)
kubectl logs -n archive deploy/archive-cleaner --since=72h | rg \"cust-9876|delete_req_2026-03-06\"
# check KMS calls in service logs
rg \"Encrypt|Decrypt|ScheduleKeyDelete\" services/*/logs | rg \"cust-9876|delete_req_2026-03-06\"
```

mike_sre: Ran the DB query — shows job id=dj-3317 status=retrying attempts=5 last_attempt=2026-03-07T02:12:14Z. archive-cleaner logs show repeated 5xx from S3 for object deletes between 2026-03-06T15:43 and 2026-03-07T02:10. No direct HSM errors in those logs.

lana_security: Good. Can we pull KMS audit trail? audit-bot can help. @audit-bot can you attach KMS key events for key=redwood-eu-enc-1 from 2026-03-06..2026-03-08 for cust-9876?

audit-bot: Attached (export id: exp-20260308-44). Events returned: CreateDataKey, Encrypt (service=archive-cleaner) at 2026-03-06T15:41:02Z, ScheduleKeyDeletion NOT observed. No HSM-privileged access events for custodial ops.

aj_engineer: So likely root cause = S3 transient 5xx causing archive-cleaner to retry and exceed its retry TTL, leaving the job in 'retrying' instead of 'completed'. KMS/HSM not implicated in unauthorized access.

jordan_csm: Customer expects evidence that objects were purged. What's the minimal artifact we can send? audit export + deletion_job row + archive-cleaner log tail? Also ETA?

lana_security: Send: 1) deletion_jobs row snapshot (dj-3317) 2) archive-cleaner log snippet showing delete attempts + s3 5xx 3) KMS audit export id (exp-20260308-44) 4) S3 lifecycle/replication checks. Redact internals and note retention policy.

mike_sre: I'll grab the log slices and S3 object manifests. One note: if the archive-cleaner failed mid-run, some objects may still be in S3 pending lifecycle; we'll include manifest and object list with checksums.

paula_support: I'll prepare the bundle to send to customer. ETA: preliminary evidence within 12h, full remediation (force-delete job + run) scheduled for 24h after approval. tagging @legal for DPA wording. :eyes:

lana_security: Thanks team. After we provide evidence, we should offer to execute manual purge and provide confirmation once archive-cleaner completes. Also add a postmortem entry to track improvement (retry/alerting).

jordan_csm: I'll update the customer with the plan and ask for confirmation window.

paula_support: closing loop here — will attach files in the ticket and ping once uploaded.
